About Us

Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

 

Role Overview

As a Sales Engineer, you will lead the technical components of the sales process. You will partner closely with Account Executives and prospective customers to design integration approaches, evaluate technical fit, and demonstrate how Constructor’s platform drives measurable business impact.

This role combines technical architecture design, consultative discovery, and cross-functional collaboration. You will act as a bridge between customer engineering teams and Constructor’s Product and Engineering teams.

This is not a demo-heavy role. Account Executives perform the majority of demonstrations at Constructor. This role requires architectural thinking, integration planning, and consultative problem-solving.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales & Solution Design

  • Lead technical discovery and solution design for prospective customers

  • Design and document integration architectures (APIs, ecommerce platforms, PIM, CMS, data pipelines)

  • Develop and support tailored Proof Schedules (lightweight POCs)

  • Deliver technical presentations to both business and technical stakeholders

  • Serve as primary technical advisor during evaluation cycles

  • Troubleshoot and triage APIs, SDKs, and integration patterns

  • Willingness to tinker and build demo prototypes and tooling

  • Build and present compelling custom technical demonstrations and integration blueprints tailored to each sales opportunity

  • Support RFP and RFI responses

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to surface prospective customer feedback to influence product roadmap and integration strategy

  • Contribute insights to the roadmap and the go-to-market strategy

  • Support enablement and training for sales teams

  • Help refine documentation, processes, and best practices within the SE function

Market & Industry Engagement

  • Stay current on ecommerce trends, AI/ML advancements, and the competitive landscape

  • Represent Constructor in prospect meetings, partner engagements, field events, and other industry engagements

  • Build strong relationships with prospective customer technical stakeholders (architects, engineers, delivery teams)

 
 

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in technical Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales Architect, or Technical Pre-Sales roles

  • Deep hands-on experience with API-first platforms: comfortable working directly with REST APIs, JSON data structures, webhooks, and SDK integration patterns, and able to troubleshoot them with Postman or similar tools

  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or similar languages, enough to read integration code, debug client-side implementations, and build lightweight prototypes or demo tooling

  • Experience designing and running custom demos or pilots with clear, business-aligned success criteria

  • Hands-on experience with coding agents to automate workflows, amplify impact, and execute at scale

  • Ability to read the room, tailor your communication to diverse audiences, and identify detractors, champions, and key decision-makers

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with a track record of producing clear technical documentation and explaining complex ideas to developers, architects, and C-suite executives alike

  • Ability to effectively articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Ability to empathize with prospects’ challenges and goals

  • Skilled listener with innate curiosity

  • Passionate about innovative technology, technical sales, and articulating value to prospects

  • Enjoys working with prospects and is comfortable interacting with C-suite executives from both technical and business perspectives

  • Professional proficiency in Italian, French,Spanish, German is a plus

 
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in enterprise ecommerce or retail technology environments

  • Hands-on familiarity with at least two major ecommerce platforms, including how each handles catalog structure, extensions, and headless versus templated frontends

  • Deep understanding of data mapping between backend systems such as PIM, ERP, or legacy search indexes into a new target schema, possibly including product and variant structures, facets, attributes, and pricing logic

  • Working knowledge of search and discovery concepts

  • Experience supporting security reviews and procurement requirements, including GDPR, data processing agreements, data residency, and ISO 27001 or SOC 2 questionnaires

  • Ability to build business value models that connect search improvements to revenue, conversion, or average order value

  • Exposure to conversational or agentic shopping experiences, or retail media and sponsored product programs

jobs.title: Staff Engineer | Voyagu
jobs.description:
Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel)

Company: Voyagu

Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there.

Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment.

About Voyagu

Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems.

The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted.

Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in.

This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first.

What you are expected to do

Technical ownership

  • Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner.

  • Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more.

  • Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources.

  • Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts.

  • Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price.

  • Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice.

  • Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work.

  • Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures.

Vision and delivery

  • Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it.

  • Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task.

  • Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking.

  • Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you.

AI-driven development

  • Build and direct teams of AI coding agents instead of writing code by hand.

  • Explain and defend how to use AI effectively.

  • Bring AI practices that are as good as Voyagu’s, or better.

Team

  • Lead the two people already working in this direction, once you have onboarded.

  • Hire as little as possible. Hiring is a last resort. Long term the direction may grow to one to three people.

What you need to succeed

  • You have worked in the travel domain, especially on integrations with supply systems. About two or more years is likely enough.

  • You understand booking versus ticket, and the statuses and states of each.

  • You have owned a large piece of a product, not a small slice.

  • You work at staff or senior level, as architect and technical lead.

  • You understand what Voyagu does and why, and you talk well with stakeholders.

  • You use AI well beyond the beginner level and have a clear view on how to use it effectively.

  • You believe small teams work. You do not think in big organisations.

  • You work in a European time zone; ideally you are based in Europe.

  • You speak Russian: engineering works mostly in Russian. Business teams speak English, and English B2 is enough.

  • Nice to have: you have seen both corporate and lean startup worlds, or a bootstrap scaleup. You may be an ex-founder or a small-company CTO who stayed hands-on.

  • Nice to have: you have run teams of agents, not only asked an agent to write a feature.

  • Nice to have: vendor-side experience building for end users. Python is the current main stack, but language skill is not important.

  • Not required: high-load experience, writing agent skills, or deep C#/legacy aviation knowledge.

What you get

  • You own a whole direction, with responsibility handed over fully.

  • You are the technical lead for integrations and supply, with no product-manager layer in between.

  • You work with AI agent teams. Voyagu will invest heavily in tokens and compute where it pays off.

  • You can bring AI practices better than Voyagu’s own, and the team will share theirs.

  • A large, technically hard platform: real-time inventory, many sources, money at stake.

  • A lean environment with few meetings and flexible hours.

  • Fully remote in Europe, with flexible contract models.

  • Equity is not standard, but it is negotiable for an exceptional candidate.

How to apply

Apply through hirehire, the agency running this search for Voyagu. The process has three stages: an engineering interview with the CTO, a travel-domain interview with the founder, and a practical case with a defence.
